test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Motor Vehicle) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a key electrical safety tip in a workshop?

options.text: Use water to clean electrical panels
Ensure electrical equipment is properly grounded
Ignore frayed wires if the device is still working

solution:
The correct answer is __Ensure electrical equipment is properly grounded**(Option 3)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Proper grounding__ ensures electrical safety by reducing the risk of electric shock.
 
• Grounding prevents accumulation of static electricity which can cause sparks or fires.
 
• It provides a safe path for excess current to flow during faults, protecting both the equipment and the user.
 
• All electrical systems in workshops must meet safety standards to avoid accidents.
 
• Regular inspection of grounding connections is essential for maintaining safety.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Why water and electricity don’t mix:**

 
 
• Using water on electrical panels can cause short circuits and electrical fires.
 
• Operating machines with wet hands increases the risk of electric shocks.
 
 
 
• **Inspecting for frayed wires:**
 
 
• Damaged wires can result in short circuits or even electrical fires.
 
• All frayed wires should be replaced immediately to ensure safety.
